Kaikōkiri, Project Support - Te Whare Manaaki Whenua - CLOSED

1.0 FTE Full time, Fixed Term to 31 December 2025
Ōtaki Campus

Te Whare Manaaki Whenua are responsible for the upkeep and maintenance of our whenua and whare on our Ōtaki campus as well as any external sites, giving effect to manaaki whenua.

 

The Kaikōkiri is the unsung hero of Te Wānanga o Raukawa, the glue that holds everything together with a smile and a can-do attitude. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to ensure the smooth and efficient administration of Te Whare Manaaki Whenua while juggling multiple tasks like a professional circus performer. You’ll provide top-notch project management support, keep the kaupapa alive and well, and foster a work environment so positive, even Mondays won't stand a chance. From maintaining databases to organising hui, you'll be the go-to person for all things administrative, making sure everything runs like a well-oiled machine. With a knack for handling competing demands and a talent for keeping everyone on the same page, you’ll be the behind-the-scenes wizard that makes magic happen at Te Wānanga o Raukawa.

This is a fantastic opportunity for anyone wanting to gain experience and knowledge within a kaupapa Māori organisation that could lead to further opportunities.

For further information or to apply, please contact:

 

Dionne Seng, Kaihautū Te Whare Tiaki Rawa

E. Dionne.seng@twor-otaki.ac.nz

P. 06 3649011 xtn 757
